Type: modern color-block area rug
Use: anchoring a seating area; living room, bedroom, home office
Style: mid-century modern, retro, contemporary
Materials: tufted pile, carved texture
Colors: light grey, coral orange, dark brown, taupe
Shape: rectangle, curved stacked bands with rounded coral ends, thin dark stripes across the middle, low pile, bold graphic presence
Feel: playful, warm, graphic
Goes with: leather chairs, dark wood floors, black side tables; mid-century or retro rooms

product.name: Amazon Brand – Rivet Modern Color-Block Area Rug, 5 x 8 Foot, Multicolor
product.description: Add interest to your home decor with this eye-catching modern-style rug. With a unique design reminiscent of modern-era abstract art, this rug has bold shapes that extend beyond its edges and rich hues that will add a splash of color to the room. 5' x 8' Pile: 100% wool This richly textured rug uses spaced-dyed yarn in a looped-and-cut technique. The thick pile makes it luxurious, and the hand-tufted construction means it is both soft and durable, perfectly suited to high-traffic indoor areas. The medium 0.3'' pile makes this rug ideal for moderate-traffic areas like bedrooms or sitting rooms Pair with rug pad (sold separately)
